_meta.input_is: the energy-sorted list BEFORE the shuffle (Pokemon.js:748)
_meta.swap_final_is: what a swap-primitive port would have produced -- stored so the test can assert we are NOT that.
_meta.what: activeChargedMoves ordering captured from a RUNNING PvPoke (master 56bc6a8b1) for all 13 supermega species at their mega-rankings default 3-charged-move movesets, x 3 CP caps x 3 opponents.
_meta.why: PvPoke reorders with splice(0,1)+push -- a ROTATE-LEFT, not a swap of slots 0 and i. The two are indistinguishable at n=2 (which is why our pre-2026-09-02 swap port was correct) and diverge at n>=3. These rows are the discriminator.
